description: This file defines utility classes and functions for manipulating and managing insert points within a Torch JIT graph, including an _InsertPoint context manager and a function to create insert point guards.

classes.name: _InsertPoint
classes.description: A context manager class that temporarily sets an insert point in a Torch JIT graph, restoring it upon exit.
